portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

Bug Fix(es):

* Using fence_watchdog in a topology after another fencing device will cause the watchdog timeout to not be considered when calculating the timeout for the fencing operation (BZ#2187422)

abstract:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

Bug Fix(es):

* Using fence_watchdog in a topology after another fencing device will cause the watchdog timeout to not be considered when calculating the timeout for the fencing operation (BZ#2187422)
